context:
Goal: you can send several asks from the waiting page, and each one reaches its writer.
Problem (goal): the page holds one ask at a time; how several queue changes the screen.
Based on (incident): owner, Nov 2 12:55 CST: "can add only one ask before Send".
Based on (read): page.html has one textarea (:795) and one sent slot (:2063); a second Send within the 8 s Undo replaces the first one's Undo.
Departs from: docs/design/page-ask-box-notes.md item 5 (one Undo at the box) — each ask gets its own row.

options.gain: Each sent ask shows its own status and its own Undo.
options.how: Each sent ask gets its own row under the box, with its status and its own Undo.
options.label: Undo on each row
options.lose: A list of rows under the box.

options.gain: You review the batch before it goes.
options.how: Asks stack in the box and go together on a final Send.
options.label: Stack, then send
options.lose: Nothing reaches the writer until the final Send; one more click.

options.how: The latest ask keeps its Undo at the box; an earlier ask still in its 8 s gets its Undo on its row.
options.label: Latest Undo at the box
options.lose: Earlier asks lose their Undo at the box; Undo has two homes.

ref: step ask-reaches-writer; mockup docs/design/page-ask-queue.html on branch rg-page-asks (3bf3e26b), states rows and stack
reply: Done: the ask queue with "Add to list" is in the page template on main, and this page runs it. Closed 07:50 CST Nov 5 in the stale-item sweep.
title: How should several asks queue on the waiting page?
why: Each ask reaches its writer at once and stays undoable.
